audit_conversation_payloads:

conversation_templates:
CREATE TABLE `conversation_templates` (
  `id` varchar(128) NOT NULL,
  `source_node_id` varchar(128) NOT NULL,
  `source_workspace_id` varchar(128) NOT NULL,
  `name` varchar(128) NOT NULL,
  `normalized_name` varchar(128) NOT NULL,
  `description` varchar(2000) NOT NULL,
  `icon` varchar(128) DEFAULT NULL,
  `status` enum('ACTIVE','ARCHIVED','DELETED') NOT NULL DEFAULT 'ACTIVE',
  `current_version_id` varchar(128) DEFAULT NULL,
  `draft_revision` int unsigned NOT NULL,
  `draft_config` json NOT NULL,
  `created_by_user_id` bigint unsigned NOT NULL,
  `updated_by_user_id` bigint unsigned NOT NULL,
  `created_at` bigint NOT NULL,
  `updated_at` bigint NOT NULL,
  `deleted_at` bigint DEFAULT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `conversation_templates_name` (`normalized_name`),
  KEY `conversation_templates_source_node_idx` (`source_node_id`),
  KEY `conversation_templates_source_workspace_idx` (`source_workspace_id`),
  KEY `conversation_templates_directory_idx` (`status`,`updated_at`,`id`),
  KEY `conversation_templates_creator_fk` (`created_by_user_id`),
  KEY `conversation_templates_updater_fk` (`updated_by_user_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `conversation_templates_creator_fk` FOREIGN KEY (`created_by_user_id`) REFERENCES `users` (`id`),
  CONSTRAINT `conversation_templates_source_node_fk` FOREIGN KEY (`source_node_id`) REFERENCES `nodes` (`id`),
  CONSTRAINT `conversation_templates_source_workspace_fk` FOREIGN KEY (`source_workspace_id`) REFERENCES `workspaces` (`workspace_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `conversation_templates_updater_fk` FOREIGN KEY (`updated_by_user_id`) REFERENCES `users` (`id`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci
enterprises:

  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),

license_activations:

license_state:

organizations:
CREATE TABLE `organizations` (

  `name` varchar(128) NOT NULL,
  `parent_organization_id` bigint unsigned DEFAULT NULL,

  `updated_at` bigint NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),

resource_grants:
CREATE TABLE `resource_grants` (
  `id` varchar(128) NOT NULL,
  `resource_type` enum('NODE','WORKSPACE','MODEL','IMAGE_MODEL','TEMPLATE') NOT NULL,
  `node_id` varchar(128) DEFAULT NULL,
  `workspace_id` varchar(128) DEFAULT NULL,
  `model_id` varchar(128) DEFAULT NULL,
  `image_model_id` varchar(128) DEFAULT NULL,
  `template_id` varchar(128) DEFAULT NULL,
  `target_type` enum('USER','ORGANIZATION','ENTERPRISE') NOT NULL,
  `target_user_id` bigint unsigned DEFAULT NULL,
  `target_organization_id` bigint unsigned DEFAULT NULL,
  `grant_authority` enum('ENTERPRISE','ORG_SUBTREE') NOT NULL,
  `grant_scope_organization_id` bigint unsigned DEFAULT NULL,
  `created_by_user_id` bigint unsigned NOT NULL,
  `created_by_role` enum('ADMIN','ORG_ADMIN') NOT NULL,
  `created_at` bigint NOT NULL,
  `resource_key` varchar(300) NOT NULL,
  `target_key` varchar(300) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `resource_grants_exact_edge` (`resource_key`,`target_key`),
  KEY `resource_grants_node_idx` (`node_id`),
  KEY `resource_grants_workspace_idx` (`workspace_id`),
  KEY `resource_grants_user_fk` (`target_user_id`),
  KEY `resource_grants_org_fk` (`target_organization_id`),
  KEY `resource_grants_model_idx` (`model_id`),
  KEY `resource_grants_image_model_idx` (`image_model_id`),
  KEY `resource_grants_template_idx` (`template_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `resource_grants_image_model_fk` FOREIGN KEY (`image_model_id`) REFERENCES `mar_agent_image_models` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  CONSTRAINT `resource_grants_model_fk` FOREIGN KEY (`model_id`) REFERENCES `mar_agent_models` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  CONSTRAINT `resource_grants_node_fk` FOREIGN KEY (`node_id`) REFERENCES `nodes` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  CONSTRAINT `resource_grants_org_fk` FOREIGN KEY (`target_organization_id`) REFERENCES `organizations` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  CONSTRAINT `resource_grants_template_fk` FOREIGN KEY (`template_id`) REFERENCES `conversation_templates` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  CONSTRAINT `resource_grants_user_fk` FOREIGN KEY (`target_user_id`) REFERENCES `users` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  CONSTRAINT `resource_grants_exact_resource` CHECK ((((`resource_type` = _utf8mb4'NODE') and (`node_id` is not null) and (`workspace_id` is null) and (`model_id` is null) and (`image_model_id` is null) and (`template_id` is null)) or ((`resource_type` = _utf8mb4'WORKSPACE') and (`node_id` is not null) and (`workspace_id` is not null) and (`model_id` is null) and (`image_model_id` is null) and (`template_id` is null)) or ((`resource_type` = _utf8mb4'MODEL') and (`node_id` is null) and (`workspace_id` is null) and (`model_id` is not null) and (`image_model_id` is null) and (`template_id` is null)) or ((`resource_type` = _utf8mb4'IMAGE_MODEL') and (`node_id` is null) and (`workspace_id` is null) and (`model_id` is null) and (`image_model_id` is not null) and (`template_id` is null)) or ((`resource_type` = _utf8mb4'TEMPLATE') and (`node_id` is null) and (`workspace_id` is null) and (`model_id` is null) and (`image_model_id` is null) and (`template_id` is not null))))
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci
workbench_notifications:
CREATE TABLE `workbench_notifications` (
  `id` varchar(36) NOT NULL,
  `user_id` bigint unsigned NOT NULL,
  `source_id` varchar(512) NOT NULL,
  `source_key` char(64) NOT NULL,
  `kind` enum('run','approval','plan','user-input') NOT NULL,
  `title` varchar(160) NOT NULL,
  `message` varchar(512) NOT NULL,
  `node_id` varchar(128) NOT NULL,
  `target_type` enum('WORKSPACE_SESSION','HOSTED_CONVERSATION') NOT NULL DEFAULT 'WORKSPACE_SESSION',
  `workspace_id` varchar(128) DEFAULT NULL,
  `session_id` varchar(128) DEFAULT NULL,
  `session_title` varchar(160) NOT NULL,
  `conversation_id` varchar(128) DEFAULT NULL,
  `run_id` varchar(128) NOT NULL,
  `created_at` bigint NOT NULL,
  `expires_at` bigint NOT NULL,
  `read_at` bigint DEFAULT NULL,
  `deleted_at` bigint DEFAULT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `workbench_notifications_user_source` (`user_id`,`source_key`),
  KEY `workbench_notifications_active` (`user_id`,`deleted_at`,`expires_at`,`created_at`),
  CONSTRAINT `workbench_notifications_user_fk` FOREIGN KEY (`user_id`) REFERENCES `users` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  CONSTRAINT `workbench_notifications_exact_target` CHECK ((((`target_type` = _utf8mb4'WORKSPACE_SESSION') and (`workspace_id` is not null) and (`session_id` is not null) and (`conversation_id` is null)) or ((`target_type` = _utf8mb4'HOSTED_CONVERSATION') and (`workspace_id` is null) and (`session_id` is null) and (`conversation_id` is not null))))
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci
conversation_template_versions:
CREATE TABLE `conversation_template_versions` (
  `id` varchar(128) NOT NULL,
  `template_id` varchar(128) NOT NULL,
  `version_number` int unsigned NOT NULL,
  `draft_revision` int unsigned NOT NULL,
  `status` enum('AVAILABLE','DISABLED','CORRUPTED','RETAINED') NOT NULL,
  `content_hash` char(64) NOT NULL,
  `manifest_hash` char(64) NOT NULL,
  `mcp_config_hash` char(64) NOT NULL DEFAULT '4f53cda18c2baa0c0354bb5f9a3ecbe5ed12ab4d8e11ba873c2f11161202b945',
  `file_count` int unsigned NOT NULL,
  `total_bytes` bigint unsigned NOT NULL,
  `host_policy_version` int unsigned NOT NULL,
  `published_by_user_id` bigint unsigned NOT NULL,
  `published_at` bigint NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `conversation_template_versions_number` (`template_id`,`version_number`),
  KEY `conversation_template_versions_status_idx` (`template_id`,`status`,`published_at`),
  KEY `conversation_template_versions_publisher_fk` (`published_by_user_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `conversation_template_versions_publisher_fk` FOREIGN KEY (`published_by_user_id`) REFERENCES `users` (`id`),
  CONSTRAINT `conversation_template_versions_template_fk` FOREIGN KEY (`template_id`) REFERENCES `conversation_templates` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci
oauth_providers:
CREATE TABLE `oauth_providers` (
  `id` varchar(128) NOT NULL,
  `name` varchar(128) NOT NULL,
  `client_id` varchar(512) NOT NULL,
  `client_secret` text NOT NULL,
  `authorization_endpoint` varchar(2048) NOT NULL,
  `token_endpoint` varchar(2048) NOT NULL,
  `userinfo_endpoint` varchar(2048) DEFAULT NULL,
  `configuration` json NOT NULL,
  `default_organization_id` bigint unsigned NOT NULL,
  `enabled` tinyint(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `tested_at` bigint DEFAULT NULL,
  `created_at` bigint NOT NULL,
  `updated_at` bigint NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `name` (`name`),
  KEY `oauth_provider_org_fk` (`default_organization_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `oauth_provider_org_fk` FOREIGN KEY (`default_organization_id`) REFERENCES `organizations` (`id`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci
oauth_transactions:
CREATE TABLE `oauth_transactions` (
  `state_hash` char(64) NOT NULL,
  `provider_id` varchar(128) NOT NULL,
  `browser_flow_id` varchar(128) NOT NULL,
  `pkce_verifier` varchar(256) DEFAULT NULL,
  `created_at` bigint NOT NULL,
  `expires_at` bigint NOT NULL,

) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci
conversation_template_publish_jobs:
CREATE TABLE `conversation_template_publish_jobs` (
  `id` varchar(128) NOT NULL,
  `template_id` varchar(128) NOT NULL,
  `source_node_id` varchar(128) NOT NULL,
  `source_workspace_id` varchar(128) NOT NULL,
  `draft_revision` int unsigned NOT NULL,
  `stage` enum('VALIDATING','ENUMERATING','COPYING','SCANNING','MANIFEST','SEALED','REGISTERED') NOT NULL,
  `status` enum('QUEUED','RUNNING','SUCCEEDED','FAILED') NOT NULL,
  `version_id` varchar(128) DEFAULT NULL,
  `error_code` varchar(80) DEFAULT NULL,
  `error_summary` varchar(1000) DEFAULT NULL,
  `requested_by_user_id` bigint unsigned NOT NULL,
  `created_at` bigint NOT NULL,
  `updated_at` bigint NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  KEY `conversation_template_publish_jobs_template_idx` (`template_id`,`created_at`,`id`),
  KEY `conversation_template_publish_jobs_status_idx` (`status`,`updated_at`),
  KEY `conversation_template_publish_jobs_version_idx` (`version_id`),
  KEY `conversation_template_publish_jobs_requester_fk` (`requested_by_user_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `conversation_template_publish_jobs_requester_fk` FOREIGN KEY (`requested_by_user_id`) REFERENCES `users` (`id`),
  CONSTRAINT `conversation_template_publish_jobs_template_fk` FOREIGN KEY (`template_id`) REFERENCES `conversation_templates` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  CONSTRAINT `conversation_template_publish_jobs_version_fk` FOREIGN KEY (`version_id`) REFERENCES `conversation_template_versions` (`id`) ON DELETE SET NULL
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci
external_identities:

  CONSTRAINT `external_identity_user_fk` FOREIGN KEY (`user_id`) REFERENCES `users` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci
